about: Best DEM sources per 1x1 degree tile: [lat, lon, quality, country, sources, fine]. Quality L=LiDAR, N=national 5-50 m model, U=USGS 3DEP, F=FABDEM / satellite; suffix s = a Sonny tile exists. Sources are tried in order, later ones fill gaps. fine = 1 if a source with <= 10 m posts covers most of the tile. Country = Natural Earth ADM0_A3. Built by packaging/build_coverage.py.
